profile.name: Symrise AG
profile.summary: Symrise AG operates as a supplier of fragrances, flavorings, cosmetic base materials and active ingredients, and functional ingredients and solutions in Europe, Africa, the Middle East, North America, the Asia Pacific, and Latin America. It operates in two segments, Taste, Nutrition & Health; and Scent & Care. The Taste, Nutrition & Health segment provides functional ingredients and product solutions used in the production of food and beverages; savory flavors; sweets, chocolate, chewing gum, baked goods, cereals, ice cream, milk, yogurt and milk alternatives; natural and sustainable ingredients for food and beverage manufacturers, baby food, and dietary supplements; product solutions and services for pet food manufacturers; sustainable ingredients and services for fish feed manufacturers to develop solutions for fish and shrimp farms; and probiotics for food supplements and functional foods. The Scent & Care segment develops, produces, and sells fragrance ingredients and compositions, aroma molecules, cosmetic ingredients, and mint flavors, as well as specific application processes for such substances. This segment's products are used by manufacturers of perfumes, personal care and cosmetic products, cleaning products, detergents, air fresheners, and oral care products. The company was founded in 1874 and is headquartered in Holzminden, Germany.
profile.summary_fr: Symrise AG est un fournisseur de parfums, d’arômes, de matériaux de base cosmétiques et d’ingrédients actifs, ainsi que d’ingrédients et de solutions fonctionnels en Europe, en Afrique, au Moyen-Orient, en Amérique du Nord, en Asie-Pacifique et en Amérique latine. Elle opère dans deux segments, Taste, Nutrition & Health; et Scent & Care. Le segment Goût, nutrition et santé fournit des ingrédients fonctionnels et des solutions de produits utilisés dans la production d'aliments et de boissons; saveurs salées; bonbons, chocolat, chewing-gum, pâtisseries, céréales, crème glacée, lait, yaourt et lait; ingrédients naturels et durables pour les fabricants d'aliments et de boissons, aliments pour bébés et compléments alimentaires; solutions de produits et services pour les fabricants d'aliments pour animaux de compagnie; ingrédients et services durables pour les fabricants d'aliments pour poissons.
